_instructions.format: This file contains a flat list of all family members with relationship IDs. Edit this to update the expandable family tree.

fields.name: Full name of the person
fields.dob: Date of birth in YYYY format
fields.dod: Date of death in YYYY format, or 'alive' if still living
fields.maidenName: Optional maiden name for married women
fields.spouseId: ID of spouse, or null if no spouse
fields.parentIds: Array of parent IDs (usually 2, can be 0-2)
fields.from_pat: Integer showing generations from Patrick Ruff (Millennial = 0, Gen X = -1, Gen Z = +1, etc.)
fields.ethnicity: Optional: Object mapping countries to percentages (must sum to 100). Calculated from parents if not manually set.
fields.home_city: Optional: String for city where person lives/lived (e.g., 'Philadelphia')
fields.home_state: Optional: String for state where person lives/lived (e.g., 'Pennsylvania' or 'PA')
fields.causeOfDeath: Optional: String for deceased individuals indicating what they died from (e.g., 'heart-attack', 'pancreatic-cancer')
fields.health_condition: Optional: Array of strings for ongoing/chronic health conditions (e.g., ['diabetes', 'heart-disease']). Applies to both living and deceased.
fields.cemetery_name: Optional: String for deceased individuals indicating cemetery name (e.g., 'Oak Hill Cemetery')
fields.cemetery_city: Optional: String for deceased individuals indicating cemetery city (e.g., 'Philadelphia')
fields.cemetery_state: Optional: String for deceased individuals indicating cemetery state (e.g., 'Pennsylvania' or 'PA')
fields.heritable_risk: Optional: Object mapping health conditions to risk levels (low/moderate/high/very-high). Auto-calculated from parents' health conditions and causes of death.
fields.heritable_traits: Optional: Object mapping trait names to genotype/phenotype info. Auto-calculated from parents for Mendelian traits (eye color, hair texture, dimples, etc.)
fields.gender: String: 'male' or 'female'. Auto-inferred from name if not specified.
fields.final_male: Boolean: True if this male is the last male descendant in his Y chromosome (paternal) line. Auto-calculated.
fields.final_female: Boolean: True if this female is the last female descendant in her mitochondrial DNA (maternal) line. Auto-calculated.

expandable_tree.description: The tree starts with the person specified in 'startPerson'. Clicking a node expands to show their spouse, siblings, and parents. Clicking parents shows their siblings and parents, etc.
expandable_tree.start_person: Set 'startPerson' to the ID of the person to start the tree with (e.g., 'patrick')

tips: All IDs must be unique strings
Use null for spouseId if person has no spouse
Empty arrays [] for parentIds, siblingIds, or childrenIds if none exist
Relationships should be bidirectional (if A is parent of B, B should be in A's childrenIds)
Use 'alive' for dod if the person is still living
Optional fields: occupation, phone, maidenName, notes - add as needed
